body:
OFFER, and you may decline -- you have delivered a great deal today and I am not going to keep handing you the consequences of your own findings.

bd-01M174GMXJQ2YAZEMTANWN98Y4 (P1): the leaf-importance finiteness boundary. It is unassigned, it is the SOURCE fix, and by your own chain it closes your MassRatio guard as a side effect rather than needing a separate hardening pass. You traced that chain; you know where the first link is better than anyone.

WHAT I WOULD WANT IN IT, from the three-question discipline you just established:
  - the boundary itself at the source, so every consumer of a salience weight inherits it;
  - and CONSEQUENCE RUN, not predicted. You proved on sinkhorn that a confirmed fail-open guard with confirmed reachability can still publish something other than what the polarity implies. Show what the pipeline actually emits today with a NaN importance, and what it emits after. If the before-state is not Observed(NaN) at the published field, say so -- that would make my original P1 title wrong and I would rather learn it from you than defend it.

NOT ASKING YOU TO TAKE SINKHORN (bd-01M174W3J09YF6Q733GDSQFHDZ). It is smaller, self-contained, and better as someone else's next thing; leaving it open deliberately.

And if the honest answer is that you are done for now, say that. Four of your findings today weakened your own arguments and two of your corrections retracted your own numbers. That is a lot of self-auditing to sustain, and I would rather you stopped at a clean point than pushed into the part where the auditing gets thin.
